purpose: Ingest and capacity-screen one defined large-order net-inflow mechanism from Tushare daily classified trades before observing historical factor returns.

source_selection.raw_exchange_level2_deferred: Raw ten-level books, order queues, tick orders, trades, and cancellations are not required until this lower-cost daily classification passes every frozen gate.

mechanism_identity.economic_mechanism: large and extra-large active-buy amount minus active-sell amount, normalized by all classified active-buy and active-sell amounts
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_jqdata_contract: This is the authorized provider substitute for the unobserved JQData large-order moneyflow mechanism frozen in docs/a_share_jqdata_moneyflow_data_contract.json.
mechanism_identity.jqdata_reactivation_policy: If JQData is later purchased, use it only for a separately frozen vendor-concordance audit. Do not add it as a second factor or search for the better vendor on returns.

source.request_mode: one completed local trading session per call

provider_definitions.classification_basis: active buy and active sell transactions derived from Level-2 orders
provider_definitions.md: transaction amount from CNY 50000 through CNY 200000
provider_definitions.lg: transaction amount from CNY 200000 through CNY 1000000
provider_definitions.provider_net_field_policy: Do not request or use net_mf_amount. Tushare documents that it cannot be reconstructed by simply subtracting the category totals. The frozen factor is a different, explicitly local category-based mechanism.

point_in_time_policy.source_time_field: trade_date normalized to the local trading session
point_in_time_policy.signal_assignment: signal-session close for a following-local-session-open entry
point_in_time_policy.residual_risk: A provider delay beyond the documented schedule can make a row unavailable for the next open; every immutable snapshot retains its retrieval timestamp.

factor.name: tushare_large_order_net_inflow_share
factor.denominator: buy_sm_amount + sell_sm_amount + buy_md_amount + sell_md_amount + buy_lg_amount + sell_lg_amount + buy_elg_amount + sell_elg_amount
factor.zero_denominator_policy: exclude the observed stock-day and keep the factor missing
factor.negative_or_missing_raw_policy: exclude and count incomplete rows; any negative raw amount aborts the partition because raw classified amounts must be nonnegative

snapshot_contract.universe_membership: use only instrument intervals overlapping each requested date; do not infer membership from present-day names

acceptance_protocol.limitations: The generic event probe retained the provider response verbatim, including fields forbidden from the canonical factor snapshot. It proves entitlement, keys, date containment, and required-field presence only. Full-history calls must enforce the exact requested-field whitelist and canonical schema.
required_checks_before_large_sync: the bound manifest and moneyflow frame digests match
the moneyflow response contains every requested key and amount field
returned keys are unique and inside the requested completed session
all required raw amount fields are numeric and nonnegative
the locally recomputed positive-denominator factor lies in [-1, 1]
no credential value appears in the manifest or frame
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: stop without a large sync, capacity audit, price access, or substitute endpoint

coverage_and_capacity_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without reading returns, changing thresholds, switching direction, adding the JQData substitute as a second factor, or adding raw Level-2 fields
